canonical_trigger_functions.name: cancel_goals_when_section_archived
canonical_trigger_functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION rakeezx.cancel_goals_when_section_archived()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if new.status='archived' and old.status<>'archived' then
    update rakeezx.class_goals g set state='cancelled',completed_at=clock_timestamp(),reward_operation_id=null,
      client_updated_at=new.client_updated_at,device_id=new.device_id
    where g.owner_id=new.owner_id and g.teaching_id in
      (select id from rakeezx.teachings where owner_id=new.owner_id and section_id=new.id) and g.state='active' and g.deleted_at is null;
  end if;
  return new;
end $function$

canonical_trigger_functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION rakeezx.guard_section_lifecycle_fields()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if tg_op = 'INSERT' then
    if new.status <> 'active' or new.archived_at is not null or new.archive_date is not null then
      raise exception using errcode='22023', message='Section lifecycle requires its command';
    end if;
  elsif (old.status,old.archived_at,old.archive_date) is distinct from (new.status,new.archived_at,new.archive_date)
    and coalesce(pg_catalog.current_setting('rakeezx.section_lifecycle_write', true),'') <> 'on' then
    raise exception using errcode='22023', message='Section lifecycle requires its command';
  elsif old.status = 'archived'
    and coalesce(pg_catalog.current_setting('rakeezx.section_lifecycle_write', true),'') <> 'on'
    and coalesce(pg_catalog.current_setting('rakeezx.section_lifecycle_delete', true),'') <> 'on' then
    raise exception using errcode='22023', message='Archived section is read-only';
  end if;
  return new;
end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION rakeezx.lock_student_lifecycle_statement()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if auth.uid() is not null then perform rakeezx.lock_student_lifecycle(auth.uid()); end if;
  return null;
end; $function$

prune_group_arrangements_for_enrollment
canonical_trigger_functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION rakeezx.prune_group_arrangements_for_enrollment()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_owner uuid; v_section text; v_row record; v_groups jsonb;
begin
  v_owner := case when tg_op='DELETE' then old.owner_id else new.owner_id end;
  for v_section in
    select distinct section_id from (values
      (case when tg_op<>'INSERT' then old.section_id else null end),
      (case when tg_op<>'DELETE' then new.section_id else null end)
    ) sections(section_id) where section_id is not null
  loop
    for v_row in
      select ga.id,ga.teaching_id,ga.groups
      from rakeezx.group_arrangements ga
      join rakeezx.teachings t on t.owner_id=ga.owner_id and t.id=ga.teaching_id and t.deleted_at is null
      join rakeezx.sections s on s.owner_id=t.owner_id and s.id=t.section_id and s.deleted_at is null
      where ga.owner_id=v_owner and t.section_id=v_section and ga.deleted_at is null and s.status='active'
      for update of ga
    loop
      v_groups := rakeezx.normalize_group_arrangement(v_owner,v_row.teaching_id,v_row.groups);
      if v_groups is distinct from v_row.groups then
        update rakeezx.group_arrangements
          set groups=v_groups,
              client_updated_at=greatest(coalesce(client_updated_at,0),coalesce(
                case when tg_op='DELETE' then old.client_updated_at else new.client_updated_at end,0)),
              device_id=coalesce(case when tg_op='DELETE' then old.device_id else new.device_id end,'server:roster-prune')
          where owner_id=v_owner and id=v_row.id;
      end if;
    end loop;
  end loop;
  return case when tg_op='DELETE' then old else new end;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION rakeezx.tombstone_class_goal_data_for_teaching()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if new.deleted_at is not null and old.deleted_at is null then
    update rakeezx.class_goals set deleted_at=new.deleted_at,client_updated_at=new.client_updated_at,device_id=new.device_id
      where owner_id=new.owner_id and teaching_id=new.id and deleted_at is null;
    update rakeezx.class_charter_selections set deleted_at=new.deleted_at,client_updated_at=new.client_updated_at,device_id=new.device_id
      where owner_id=new.owner_id and teaching_id=new.id and deleted_at is null;
  end if;
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION rakeezx.tombstone_class_rules_for_teaching()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if new.deleted_at is not null and old.deleted_at is null then
    update rakeezx.class_rules
       set deleted_at = new.deleted_at,
           client_updated_at = new.client_updated_at,
           device_id = new.device_id
     where owner_id = new.owner_id
       and teaching_id = new.id
       and deleted_at is null;
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$
